difficulty_ladder.title: Difficulty ladder (boredom / flow / overload), 2 rounds
difficulty_ladder.description: Katahira et al. 2018 / Ewing et al. 2016 paradigm: the same mental-arithmetic task at three difficulty levels, 6-min blocks, two rounds, counterbalanced. Flow is expected only in the matched-difficulty block. About 47 min.

blocks.label: Rest, eyes open
blocks.instruction: Sit still, eyes open, look at the fixation dot. Breathe normally. This is the EEG baseline.

blocks.label: Rest, eyes closed
blocks.instruction: Close your eyes and sit still until you hear nothing new for a minute. (Alpha reactivity check.)

shuffle.label: Easy arithmetic
shuffle.instruction: Answer the sums. They are deliberately trivial and slow.

shuffle.label: Matched arithmetic
shuffle.instruction: Answer as fast and accurately as you can. Difficulty adapts to keep you at about 80 % correct.

shuffle.label: Overload arithmetic
shuffle.instruction: Answer as fast as you can. The problems are too hard on purpose; keep trying.

between.label: Pause
between.instruction: Rate the block, then relax. The next block starts automatically.

blocks.label: Rest, eyes open
blocks.instruction: Sit still, eyes open. Done after this.

sim_quick.title: Quick simulator check (about 9 min)
sim_quick.description: Shortened difficulty ladder for bench checks with --sim: 60 s rest, two rounds of three 60 s blocks, 20 s pauses.

blocks.label: Rest, eyes open
blocks.instruction: Sit still, eyes open, look at the dot.

shuffle.label: Matched arithmetic
shuffle.instruction: Answer as fast and accurately as you can.

shuffle.label: Overload arithmetic
shuffle.instruction: Answer as fast as you can.

free_work.title: Free work with ratings every 5 min
free_work.description: 3 min rest baseline, then 40 min of your own focused work with a flow rating prompt every 5 min. For ecological checks, not for the primary gate.

blocks.instruction: Sit still, eyes open, look at the fixation dot.
